g2: median inner iterations per solve, last 3 outer iterations / first 3, pass <= 10 (NaN if fewer than 6 outer iterations)
products: applications of P, A, A' inside the Krylov solves (counted); preconditioner applications in precond_applies

settings.early_stop: abort_cap: fail_limit consecutive solves missing atol_k; abort_g2: G2 ratio > 10 from 6 outer iterations on
settings.inner_stopping: oracle: ||b - K dx||_2 <= atol_k on the explicit reduced matrix, checked every Krylov iteration
settings.trimr_tricg_M: kron: tau = alpha + delta, M = I (product-only); dense: M = (P + delta I)^-1 by dense Cholesky (counted in precond_applies)
